description: This file contains interface definitions for reminder-related grain interfaces in an Orleans-based project, including data record types for reminder state.

classes.name: ReminderState
classes.description: A record class representing the state of a reminder, including reminder details, registration times, fired times, and logs.

methods.name: StartReminder
methods.description: Initiates a reminder with a specified name, optional period, and validation flag.

methods.name: StopReminder
methods.description: Stops a reminder by name or by reminder object.

methods.name: GetReminderPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the period of a specified reminder.

methods.name: GetReminderDueTimeAndPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the due time and period of a specified reminder.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Gets a counter value associated with a name.

methods.name: GetReminderObject
methods.description: Retrieves the reminder object for a specified reminder name.

methods.name: GetRemindersList
methods.description: Returns a list of all registered reminders.

methods.name: GetReminderStates
methods.description: Returns a dictionary of all reminder states keyed by reminder name.
